summary: GEE Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Cooperation Agreement with Star Equity Fund, LP, an activist shareholder. Star Equity agreed to withdraw its director nomination and business proposal for the 2026 Annual Meeting and cease solicitation activities. In exchange, GEE Group committed to declassify its Board, electing all directors annually starting with the 2026 meeting, with staggered transition. Star Equity also agreed to vote in line with Board recommendations (with exceptions for ISS/Glass Lewis and extraordinary transactions) and to customary standstill provisions. The agreement resolves imminent proxy contest pressure. What to watch: Board declassification implementation and Star Equity's continued ownership and influence.
